svg.title: Montevideo units worked example over 10 minutes
svg.desc: Ten-minute synthetic IUPC strip. Resting pressure 15 mmHg (dashed line). Four contractions at 1, 3.5, 6 and 8.5 minutes peak at 65, 70, 60 and 75 mmHg; arrows measure each peak above resting pressure: 50, 55, 45 and 60 mmHg. MVU = 50 + 55 + 45 + 60 = 210. FHR about 140 bpm with moderate variability above.
